title: I can receive Thunderbird message but I cannot send.
creator: HarveyV
content:
Thunderbird cannot send email — Roadrunner account

I use Thunderbird on Windows 11 with a legacy Spectrum/Roadrunner email address (@nycap.rr.com).

The problem started recently. I can receive email normally through Thunderbird, but cannot send.

What I've established:

I can both send and receive successfully through Spectrum Webmail.

Thunderbird's outgoing server is mail.twc.com.

SMTP port is 587.

Connection security is STARTTLS.

Authentication is Normal Password.

Username is my full Roadrunner email address.

Windows PowerShell Test-NetConnection to mail.twc.com on port 587 reports TcpTestSucceeded: True.

Thunderbird's connection test still fails.

Antivirus is McAfee LiveSafe, with Advanced Firewall enabled.

The exact Thunderbird error is:

"Sending of the message failed. The message could not be sent because connecting to Outgoing server (SMTP) mail.twc.com failed."

I'd appreciate help identifying why Thunderbird cannot establish its SMTP connection when Windows can reach the server and Spectrum Webmail works.
